title: If The Apple Never Fell — The Chewton Theory

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 1666. What if that apple... NEVER fell?
lines.ttsText: Sixteen sixty-six. What if that apple... never fell?

lines.speaker: chewton
lines.text: Wait... why is it floating? Hello? Physics?
lines.ttsText: Wait... why is it floating? Hello? Physics?

lines.speaker: apple
lines.text: Bro, you never invented gravity! I don't HAVE to drop!
lines.ttsText: Bro, you never invented gravity! I don't HAVE to drop!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Without Chewton's gravity, the whole world forgot how to pull down!
lines.ttsText: Without Chewton's gravity, the whole world forgot how to pull down!

lines.speaker: chewton
lines.text: Wait... NO gravity means NO physics homework?!
lines.ttsText: Wait... no gravity means no physics homework?!

lines.speaker: apple
lines.text: If you skip gravity and calculus, students worship you!
lines.ttsText: If you skip gravity and calculus, students worship you!

lines.speaker: chewton
lines.text: Forget gravity. Call me Sir Isaac CHEWTON! Zero gravity, zero exams!
lines.ttsText: Forget gravity, call me Sir Isaac Chewton, zero gravity, zero exams!

lines.speaker: apple
lines.text: Just kidding. Subscribe before I drop again!
lines.ttsText: Just kidding! Subscribe before I drop again!

sfxEvents.description: Apple snaps off branch and falls partway
Chewton pokes apple; apple boings into his nose
Record scratch before talking apple reveal
Cartoon eyes and mouth pop onto apple
Puffy white wig and quill detach and float upward
Whip transition into zero-G modern chaos montage
Floating textbook, coffee mug/blobs, and pizza appear
Dramatic spotlight and cool 3D sunglasses snap onto Chewton
Apple dives straight down toward Chewton's head
Apple SLAMS onto Chewton's head with giant shockwave
Spinning cartoon stars chime around dazed Chewton
